'''Two-Tailed Rat''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}. Three appear together in the encounter.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Two-Tailed Rat}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Scratch
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Disease Bite
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Screech
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 1 {{BD2|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Call for Backup
|Intent = Summon
|Effect = Summons a new {{M2|Two-Tailed Rat}}.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Each rat starts with a different move: one uses {{Int2|Two-Tailed Rat|Scratch}}, one uses {{Int2|Two-Tailed Rat|Disease Bite}}, and one uses {{Int2|Two-Tailed Rat|Screech}}. After the first turn, each rat randomly picks from {{Int2|Two-Tailed Rat|Scratch}}, {{Int2|Two-Tailed Rat|Disease Bite}}, or {{Int2|Two-Tailed Rat|Screech}} each turn. Cannot use the same move twice in a row.

After at least two turns, a rat may use {{Int2|Two-Tailed Rat|Call for Backup}} to summon a new rat. Each rat can only summon once, and the group can summon up to three times total.

== Notes ==
* Despite its name, the Two-Tailed Rat doesn't visually have two tails and instead has one tail that is forked at the end.
* The {{M|Fungi Beast|Fungi Beasts}} from Slay the Spire 1 appear to be Two-Tailed Rats corpses with a fungal infection controlling them.
